# Load libraries

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(clustree)
library(scater)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(egg)
library(workflowr)
library(here)
library(sessioninfo)
library(viridis)
library(Polychrome)

source(here("code", "helper_functions.R"))
source(here("code", "load_colour_schemes.R"))

RERUN_ALL <- FALSE
```

# Load dataset

```{r}
seu_int <- readRDS(here("data", "workflow", 
                        "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Integrated_clustered.Subclustered.Seurat.rds"))
seu_int$seurat_clusters <- factor(seu_int$seurat_clusters)
```

```{r}
ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS <- c(light.colors(n = 24), sky.colors(n = 10))
names(ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS) <- levels(seu_int$seurat_clusters)
```

# Find the best labels for cell types and clusters

## Examine labels from each reference and clusters

```{r, fig.asp=1}
DimPlot(seu_int, reduction = 'umap', group.by = "pan_fetal.majority_voting",) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_CELL_TYPE_COLOURS[levels(seu_int$pan_fetal.majority_voting)]) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(ncol = 3, override.aes = list(size=2))) +
  bottom_legend

DimPlot(seu_int, reduction = 'umap', group.by = "fetal_organ.majority_voting",) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_CELL_TYPE_COLOURS[levels(seu_int$fetal_organ.majority_voting)]) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(ncol = 3, override.aes = list(size=2))) +
  bottom_legend

DimPlot(seu_int, reduction = 'umap', label = TRUE, label.size = 5, 
        group.by = "seurat_clusters") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS[levels(seu_int$seurat_clusters)]) +
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow = 3, override.aes = list(size=2))) +
  bottom_legend
```

```{r, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}
seu_int@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = seurat_clusters,
             fill = pan_fetal.majority_voting)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill") +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  ylab("Proportion") + xlab("Seurat Clusters") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ALL_CELL_TYPE_COLOURS[levels(seu_int$pan_fetal.majority_voting)]) +
  bottom_legend + guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol = 4)) + theme(legend.title=element_blank()) + rotate_x_labels +
  ggtitle("Pan_Fetal_Human") -> p1

seu_int@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = seurat_clusters,
             fill = fetal_organ.majority_voting)) +
  geom_bar(position="fill") +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  ylab("Proportion") + xlab("Seurat Clusters") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ALL_CELL_TYPE_COLOURS[levels(seu_int$fetal_organ.majority_voting)]) +
  bottom_legend + guides(fill=guide_legend(ncol = 4)) + theme(legend.title=element_blank()) + rotate_x_labels +
  ggtitle("Developing_Human_Organs") -> p2

p1 | p2
```

```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=6}
seu_int@meta.data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = seurat_clusters,
               y = nCount_RNA)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "area") +
    geom_quasirandom(aes(color = seurat_clusters)) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme_cowplot(12) + rotate_x_labels +
    scale_color_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
    no_legend + ggtitle("QC Metrics by seurat_clusters") -> p1

seu_int@meta.data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = seurat_clusters,
               y = nFeature_RNA)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "area") +
    geom_quasirandom(aes(color = seurat_clusters)) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme_cowplot(12) + rotate_x_labels +
    scale_color_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
    no_legend -> p2

seu_int@meta.data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = seurat_clusters, fill = seurat_clusters)) +
    geom_bar() +
    theme_cowplot(12) + rotate_x_labels +
    scale_fill_manual(values = ALL_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
    no_legend -> p3
  
p1 | p2 | p3
```

## Create refined cluster labels

The one-vs-rest marker gene analysis approach does not work well when there are many clusters of the same cell type arising from overclustering. This is especially evident for the keratinocytes and macrophages, thus we will merge these cluster labels.

```{r}
seu_int$refined_clusters <- as.character(seu_int$seurat_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("0_0", "0_1", "0_2", "0_3", "0_4", "0_5",
                                                                   "0_7", "0_8"), 
                                   "Cluster_01", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("0_6"), 
                                   "Cluster_02", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("1_1"), 
                                   "Cluster_03", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("1_6", "Dendritic cells"), 
                                   "Cluster_04", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("1_9"), 
                                   "Cluster_05", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("1_0", "1_2", "1_3", "1_4", 
                                                                   "1_5", "1_7", "1_8"), 
                                   "Cluster_06", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("2_0", "2_1"), 
                                   "Cluster_07", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("2_2", "2_3", "2_4"), 
                                   "Cluster_08", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("3_0"), 
                                   "Cluster_09", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("3_1"), 
                                   "Cluster_10", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("3_2"), 
                                   "Cluster_11", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("3_3"), 
                                   "Cluster_12", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("4"), 
                                   "Cluster_13", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("5"), 
                                   "Cluster_14", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("6"), 
                                   "Cluster_15", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("NK cells / cytotoxic lymphocytes"), 
                                   "Cluster_16", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- ifelse(seu_int$refined_clusters %in% c("Proliferating cells"), 
                                   "Cluster_17", 
                                   seu_int$refined_clusters)

seu_int$refined_clusters <- factor(seu_int$refined_clusters, 
                                   levels = sort(unique(seu_int$refined_clusters)))
```

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
DimPlot(seu_int, reduction = 'umap', label = TRUE, label.size = 5, 
        group.by = "refined_clusters") +
  scale_color_manual(values = REFINED_CLUSTER_COLOURS) + 
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow = 3, override.aes = list(size=2))) + blank_axes +
  bottom_legend
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
seu_int@meta.data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = refined_clusters, fill = refined_clusters)) +
    geom_bar() +
    geom_text(aes(label = after_stat(count)), stat = "count", vjust = -0.5) +
    theme_cowplot(12) + rotate_x_labels +
    scale_fill_manual(values = REFINED_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
    no_legend + ggtitle("Number of cells per cluster") +
    ylab("Number of cells") + xlab("")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
seu_int@meta.data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = refined_clusters,
               y = nCount_RNA)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "area") +
    geom_quasirandom(aes(color = refined_clusters)) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme_cowplot(12) + rotate_x_labels +
    scale_color_manual(values = REFINED_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
    no_legend + ggtitle("QC Metrics by refined_clusters") -> p1

seu_int@meta.data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = refined_clusters,
               y = nFeature_RNA)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "area") +
    geom_quasirandom(aes(color = refined_clusters)) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme_cowplot(12) + rotate_x_labels +
    scale_color_manual(values = REFINED_CLUSTER_COLOURS) +
    no_legend -> p2
  
p1 | p2
```

# Naming the clusters

These names map directly onto the refined clusters but are added to the object for use in plots.

```{r}
CLUSTER_NAMES <- c(
  Cluster_01 = "Keratinocytes",
  Cluster_02 = "Erythroid",
  Cluster_03 = "Kidney epithelium",
  Cluster_04 = "Dendritic cells",
  Cluster_05 = "Fibroblasts / mesenchyme",
  Cluster_06 = "Macrophages",
  Cluster_07 = "ILC3",
  Cluster_08 = "T cells",
  Cluster_09 = "Unknown",
  Cluster_10 = "Lung epithelium (low confidence)",
  Cluster_11 = "Neural crest-like",
  Cluster_12 = "Lung epithelium",
  Cluster_13 = "Neuronal-like",
  Cluster_14 = "Ciliated",
  Cluster_15 = "Mast cells",
  Cluster_16 = "NK cells / cytotoxic lymphocytes",
  Cluster_17 = "Proliferating T cells"
)

saveRDS(CLUSTER_NAMES, here("data", "workflow", "CLUSTER_NAMES.rds"))
```

```{r}
seu_int$cluster_names <- unname(CLUSTER_NAMES[seu_int$refined_clusters])
seu_int$cluster_names <- sortedFactor(seu_int$cluster_names)
```

```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=6}
seu_int@meta.data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = cluster_names, fill = cluster_names)) +
    geom_bar() +
    geom_text(aes(label = after_stat(count)), stat = "count", vjust = -0.5) +
    theme_cowplot(12) + rotate_x_labels +
    scale_fill_manual(values = CLUSTER_NAME_COLOURS) +
    no_legend + ggtitle("Number of cells per cluster") +
    ylab("Number of cells") + xlab("")
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
DimPlot(seu_int, group.by = "cluster_names") +
  scale_color_manual(values = CLUSTER_NAME_COLOURS)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(seu_int, here("data", "workflow", "AmnioSC_ALL_optimised_ref.Refined_labels.Seurat.rds"))
```
